method: fresh shallow clone of the pinned commit; classified first (access method, demand signal, retry and pacing, failure, plumbing), then compared with ECDEV

coverage.not_read: cli.ts, index.ts, schemas.ts, config.ts, rest of semrush-api.ts, dist/, tests
coverage.statement: Bounded semantic review of the files named, not the whole source. No extinction is claimed.

rows.behaviour: A sliding one-second window limiter polled every 100 ms; GET responses cached by URL and parameters for a configured TTL; retries on 429/500/502/503/504 up to 3 times at 2, 4 and 6 s, ignoring Retry-After.
rows.failure_semantics: retry delays are fixed and do not look at the server's instruction; the API key is a query parameter and is part of the cache key
rows.ecdev_today: Provider calls honour the server's retry time, record it, and keep secrets out of URLs, keys and receipts.
rows.knowledge: The retry set (429, 500, 502, 503, 504) sits inside what ECDEV retries and agrees with Scrapy's list on those codes. Weaknesses: delays are fixed at 2, 4 and 6 s and ignore Retry-After, and the API key is a query parameter that is also part of the cache key. Nothing to absorb.

rows.behaviour: Keyword reports request phrase, monthly volume (Nq), CPC (Cp), competition (Co), result count (Nr), twelve-month trend (Td), intent (In) and difficulty (Kd); rank reports request position and traffic columns.
rows.knowledge: Volume plus a twelve-month trend vector per phrase is a labelled demand series; see junglescout.keyword-demand-api for the question and its blocker.
rows.oracle_or_benchmark: answerable with a paid key; not run
